```plato

    // The latitude/longitude point on the unit sphere: U wraps around the equator,
    // V runs from the north pole (V = 0) to the south pole (V = 1).
    UnitSpherePoint(uv: UvCoordinate): Vector3D
    {
        var theta = uv.U.Turns;
        var phi = (uv.V * 0.5).Turns;
        return (phi.Sin * theta.Cos, phi.Sin * theta.Sin, phi.Cos);
    }
```
